sources.said: Although this has been the case, more still needs to be done as there has been no comprehensive Film fund for production, acquisition and distribution. ... The 2023 National Film Policy will open up financing systems by implementing Public Private Partnership in the Film Industry as well as establish a national Film Fund. ... 5.1.5 The Ministry responsible for Finance The Ministry shall; a) Facilitate the financing of the industry through budgetary allocation; and b) Introduce rebates and incentives according to global best practices.

The quota's level was sought in the IBA Act 2002 and the 2010 amendment (both read whole; the 2010 scan read from its page images after OCR stalled on the shared machine), the IBA's Standard Operating Procedures and its Licensing Requirements 2017: none states a percentage. value.localContentQuotas: mandatory (the policy's words); the IBA Act empowers the IBA to set required levels of local content
value.route: commissioning by public and private media (policy 5.1.19); ZNBC the main platform
value.statute: IBA Act s.24(1) as substituted in 2010: a commercial broadcaster must carry 'an appropriate amount of local or national programming' and 'significant portions of Zambian drama'; no percentage in the Act; any level sits in licence conditions (s.22(5)(i))

sources.said: According to the Independent Broadcasting Authority (IBA), as of 2023, the number of television stations stands at 54 of which 46 are operational. Of the operational stations; 29 are commercial; while 6 are public service broadcaster; 6 are subscription management service, and one has landing rights. ... This growth was further catalysed by the introduction of mandatory local content quotas. These quotas encouraged local content production, however, there were still insufficiencies in the capacity to meet the demand. ... 5.1.19 Public and Private Media Institutions The Public and Private Media shall; a) Facilitate funding through commissioning, publicity, training and distribution b) Provide platforms to showcase local Film productions.
(j) to develop regulations in regard to advertising, sponsorship, local content, and media diversity and ownership; ... (iii) on the required levels of local content and other
